description: Rounds a number up, away from zero.

params.description: Any real number that will be rounded up.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The number of digits to round to. If this argument is negative, the number will be rounded to the left of the decimal point.If it is equal to zero, the number will be rounded to the nearest integer.
params.name: arg2

signature: ROUNDUP(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
